verdict.rationale: Superpowers is distributed through browsable listings: its own Claude Code marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace`), a claude.com plugins listing page, and an Antigravity Marketplace manifest. The marketplace README also advertises a 'Skills-search tool for discovery' across 20+ skills. However, that search tool appears to be part of the installed plugin rather than a pre-install catalog, and the marketplace mainly lists Superpowers' own offering rather than a broad searchable registry. missing for 10: evidence of searching or browsing individual skills before install, a broader registry or leaderboard with ranking or filtering, hands-on corroboration of the discovery flow.
